# Objective

Apply the user-confirmed disposition of external review round 2 (2026-10-21):
six code fixes plus abort() logging plus point-2 documentation. Point 2 (Phred
heuristic) deliberately kept unchanged — only its error message and README
wording improved. Executed 2026-10-21/22; report:
`20261022-092847_review2-fixes.report.qmd`.

# What was done (as executed)

1. **P1 — per-mate comparisons for paired BAMs.** The scan routes paired
   records to separate R1/R2 reservoirs for `paired_short`; read-level sample
   metrics (`read_length`, `mean_read_quality`, `gc_content`, `n_content`)
   compare on R1/R2 strata; `mapq` stays full-scan `READS`; `insert_size`
   stays `PAIR`; unpaired records stay pooled (reported, not compared when
   empty); metrics/distribution rows gained per-mate strata; `sampled_count`
   totals across strata. `mapq`/`prepare_group` plumbing added.
2. **P1 — order-independent reference checksums.** M5 values aggregate per
   contig across every BAM; ≥2 distinct values ⇒ one conflict finding naming
   contigs and datasets; absent checksums keep the identity-unverified REVIEW.
3. **P1 — approval requires an assessed threshold.** When no row was assessed
   against a threshold, technical status is MISSING_EVIDENCE and the group
   INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, regardless of `require_thresholds`; assessed rows
   still decide when others are unthresholded; single-dataset groups (zero
   rows) stay COMPATIBLE.
4. **P2 — abs(TLEN) insert eligibility.** `TLEN != 0` gate, abs value used;
   first-in-pair/proper/primary/mapped gates unchanged; README rule updated.
5. **P2 — streaming comparisons.** Per-pair rows stream into the comparisons
   StagedWriter; findings stream into a findings StagedWriter with sequential
   deterministic IDs; `TechnicalAssessment` (feed/finalize) replaces the batch
   loop, `evaluate_group` stays a working wrapper; HTML gets bounded previews
   (200 findings / 500 comparisons) plus true totals; metric rows stream as a
   generator.
6. **P2 — exact sorted-input Wasserstein.** `_Prepared` sorts each dataset
   once; pairs use a merge-based exact W1 (no sort per pair); equivalence
   locked against SciPy (ties included); `STATS_VERSION` bumped to
   `sorted-merge-w1-jsd-base2-v2`.
7. `StagedWriter.abort()` logs cleanup failures (never raises).
8. Phred heuristic kept: error message states the exact whole-file rule and
   resolution; README section extended. (One process miss: the fastq.py
   message edit was initially left unstaged — caught by `git status` before
   the docs commit and landed as `f9ae9ee`.)
9. Example fix: `make_examples.py` BAMs now carry both mates; example 04
   returned from a fixture-induced INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE to REVIEW.

`src/seqconsistency/{models,bam,comparison,statistics,policy,pipeline,metrics,parquet_io,html_report,fastq}.py`,
`tests/{test_policy,test_bam,test_comparison,test_statistics,test_e2e}.py`,

`benchmarks/results-2026-10-21.{json,md}` (re-measured),
`docs/plans/**`, `docs/misc/**`.

# Verification (results)

1. New regression test per fix from the reviewer's reproductions: mate swap
   (EXCEED 30.0 both strata, REVIEW), M5 orders abc/bac/cab, empty-threshold
   policy (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), RF-oriented pairs (100/100 observed),
   30-dataset streaming run (5,220 rows complete, bounded HTML preview),
   SciPy equivalence + zero-argsort, example outcomes.
2. Full suite including the two slow memory tests: 181 passed; mypy strict and
   ruff clean.
3. Benchmark re-measured on an idle machine (idle-gated; started at load1
   3.04/load5 5.85): pair scaling −65/−44/−41/−32% at 5/10/20/40 datasets;
   BAM 64.1k rec/s (+4.6%); FASTQ within noise; peak RSS flat (959.7 MiB) at
   4× reads; worker-4 CLI 3.02 s.
4. All eight examples at documented decisions after the fixture fix.
